An optional NetBox block adds source-of-truth lookups. Do NOT use when the target is not a NAPALM-supported network device (Kubernetes clusters, hypervisor VMs, and cloud consoles are out of scope — route those elsewhere). Common multi-vendor device operations with a built-in governance harness (audit, policy, token budget, undo, risk-tiers).
skills.name: Network AIops
